# Captain Brunhilde von Flamme

> **Captain of The Carroburg**, Imperial Navy Fast Patrol Boat City-Class. **Distant relative von Bildhofens** Middenland. Famille a pratiquement payé le bateau pour acheter son grade. **Incompetent socialite + Ulrican-leaning** = peut refuser missions pro-Sigmarite. **À NE PAS CONFONDRE** avec [[Brunhilde Klaglich]] (cultiste Slaaneshi MORTE S38 Arc 5).

## Identité publique
- **Titre** : **Captain Brunhilde von Flamme**, Imperial Navy (City-Class Fast Patrol Boat).
- **Carrière canon** : **Human Boatswain (Silver 5)**.
- **Famille** : **distantly related to Bildhofens** Middenland — famille successfully rebuilding influence post-obscurité. **Famille a pratiquement payé entire boat** = earned her rank.
- **Personnalité canon (ch.9 l.22)** : *« Brunhilde has very little grasp of river life or military matters, but enjoys the attention and the camaraderie, even if it is enforced. She does cut quite a dash in her extravagant interpretation of the Imperial Navy captain's uniform, however. She knows her limitations and is content to leave her first officer in charge of the day-to-day running of the boat »*.
- **Apparence** : *« Very Ostentatious Captain's Uniform, Preposterous Hat, Telescope »*.
- **Allégeance canon (ch.9 l.24)** : *« patriotically enthusiastic about Empire, also loyal to family + wishes Ulrican faction in civil war to prosper. Easily reconciles these provided nothing comes up to put those two sides at odds in her mind. If conflict between Emperor and Cult of Ulric/Ulrican faction → becomes increasingly hesitant decisions → defaults to doing nothing »*.
- **Statut** : [VIVANTE — ALLIÉE NEUTRE]

## Source
- **EiR ch.9 l.21-40** *Captain Brunhilde von Flamme* + statbloc Boatswain Silver 5.

- **EiR ch.9 l.108-110** Bon Voyage : *« strutting around the deck, pulling out her ornate brass telescope — a gift from uncle Tristan — and surveying the horizon as if she were on the ocean »*. Crew eye-rolls.
- **EiR ch.9 l.282-285** Nuln→Streissen : *« Von Flamme is content to row her marines into the ground, if necessary, even beyond the Imperial Navy's regulations »*.

## Le Carroburg (ch.9 l.86-100)

**Imperial Navy Fast Patrol Boat City-Class** :

| Vehicle Enc | Carries | Motive Power | Move | Toughness | Wounds | Length (Yards) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 180 | 120 | Oars/Sails | 10 | 60 | 140 | 35 |

- 2 banks of 7 oars side. 28 oarsmen + marines doubling firepower+oarpower.
- **Armaments** : 2 cannons (1 sur chaque flanc, dont **Bernard/Bernie**) + 8 swivel guns (4 front, 4 side). Marines all Ranged (Engineering) Skill 55.
- **Cargo space limited** : pas d'horses.
- **Quarters cramped** : Grissen moved to ship's prison cell pour PJ confort.
- **Mainsail proudly displays Golden Imperial death's-head**.

## Apparitions par session

### Arc 7 ch.9 (S65+)
- **[S?]** — **Carroburg part Altdorf vers Averheim** avec PJ. Brunhilde strut deck.
- **Kemperbad-Nuln** : sun shining, wind perfect. Brunhilde discute météo Grissen (souvent fausse).
- **Nuln** : Hans Knees delays. 2 jours dismantle rigging + jam.
- **Nuln→Streissen** : marines aux rames extreme — Grissen tries reason Brunhilde behind back.
- **Streissen** : flotilla Leitdorf blockade. **Si PJ pas confiance + Brunhilde/Grissen → refuse risky maneuvers**.
- **Averheim** : *« She is prepared to wait for their return for a month, before returning back to Altdorf to report them missing »* (canon ch.9 l.444).

## Ce que les PJ savent
- Captain Carroburg = noble incompétent.
- Grissen vraie commande.
- Loyale Empire + famille + Ulric.

## MJ-only
- **Pas cultiste — noble socialite simple**.
- **Famille von Bildhofen rebuild influence** : ce voyage = leverage politique.
- **Si PJ poussent contre Ulric direct** = défaut **doing nothing** = mission compromised.
- **Backup loyale** : si PJ Sigmarite-perceived, Brunhilde temporise.

## Hooks Arc 7
- **Gérer ego Brunhilde** + earn Grissen trust = mission smooth.
- **Streissen blockade** : run = require Brunhilde + Grissen tous deux confiance.
- **Carroburg pas access Kemperbad climax ch.13** : reste à Averheim ou retour pré-climax (canon ch.13 *Carroburg* peut être à Altdorf).
